traditionalDress.men: Dhoti with panjabi or kurta is a classic Bengali traditional combination for men.
traditionalDress.women: Saree, especially the drape associated with Bengal; handloom traditions include Baluchari and Tant.

festivals.name: Durga Puja
festivals.description: West Bengal's largest festival, celebrated with elaborate pandals, artistic idols, music, food and community gatherings; Kolkata's festival was inscribed by UNESCO in 2021.

festivals.name: Poila Boishakh
festivals.description: The Bengali New Year, celebrated with new-year greetings, cultural programmes and festive foods.

festivals.name: Kali Puja
festivals.description: An important autumn festival in Bengal centred on the worship of Goddess Kali and illuminated neighbourhood celebrations.

folklore: Bengal's folklore draws on village songs, Baul traditions, devotional narratives and literary storytelling. Figures and stories from Mangalkavya and later Bengali literature continue to shape popular cultural memory.
